progression.narrative: The performance opens on A5 and dwells most on G in Phrase 1. Phrase 2 (0:59.8) introduces D, centred on G. Phrase 9 (3:12.4) introduces C, centred on G. Phrase 12 (3:35.4) introduces Ak, centred on F. The line peaks at C5 (518.8 Hz) at 3:34.3. It closes on G4, not the tonic (Ek4 → G4 → G4 → G4 → G4 → G4).
